title: Fix mobilePlanets hydration mismatch
description: SpaceField.tsx mobilePlanets() runs during render behind typeof window check: server HTML has 3 planets, mobile client renders 2 → React hydration mismatch on every mobile load. Fix: compute in useEffect/useState mounted pattern, or render all and hide via CSS.
acceptance_criteria: No hydration warning in mobile viewport; planet count consistent between SSR and client.

title: Fix reduced-motion resize leaving stale starfield
description: SpaceField.tsx: the reduce early-return (render once, line ~114) runs before the resize listener is registered (line ~155). Reduced-motion users who resize/orientation-change get a blank or stretched canvas. Fix: register a lightweight resize handler (resize + re-render static frame) before the reduce return.
acceptance_criteria: With prefers-reduced-motion on, resizing the window re-renders the static starfield at the new size.

title: Fix planet drift snap-jump + desync planet loops
description: SpaceField.tsx:188-194. Planet x/y are single values with repeat:Infinity and times:[0,.5,1] — they animate 0→drift then teleport to 0 every 9s. Also all 3 planets share the same 9s duration/start, pulsing in sync. Fix: keyframe arrays [0,drift,0] for x/y, per-planet durations (7/9/11s) and phase offsets.
acceptance_criteria: Planets drift back and forth smoothly with no visible jump; the three loops are visibly out of sync.
